rebuild_plan.purpose: Check whether the target-wise capped bridge survives when bridge choices are learned inside outer folds.
allowed_operations: choose per-target bridge families and caps inside the outer-training rows only
score only on untouched outer-validation rows
reject any cap that relies on full-OOF target loss or hidden-test movement alone
blocked_operations: reusing ID249's full-OOF target-wise selection as proof
treating a capped test delta as a substitute for nested validation

rebuild_plan.purpose: Check whether the pair/logit blend signal survives when target choices are learned inside outer folds.
allowed_operations: choose target-wise single/pair/logit blend configs inside the outer-training rows only
score only on untouched outer-validation rows
carry full-train test predictions only after the nested OOF score is reviewed
blocked_operations: using full OOF target loss to choose a target config
promoting a submission CSV directly from existing ID268/276/278 artifacts

rebuild_plan.purpose: Test whether the extreme calibration signal is real or only a full-OOF artifact.
allowed_operations: fit isotonic/quantile calibrators only on inner-training predictions
choose calibration family and quantile count inside inner folds
penalize extreme probabilities and per-target instability before scoring
blocked_operations: fitting isotonic or quantile maps on the same OOF rows used for evaluation
treating local CV below 0.40 as leaderboard evidence without anchor explanation

rebuild_plan.purpose: Reject any rebuild that cannot explain the known public outcomes.
required_checks: ID287-like local-frontier movement must be penalized
ID329-like local gain must not be mistaken for public improvement
candidate must improve robust nested score without large movement away from ID178

decision.next_action: Implement a true model-level nested rebuild lane before any leaderboard-facing promotion.
decision.reason: The selected source IDs preserve signal under fold-internal replay, but every selected source is non-nested and most are high/extreme-risk full-OOF calibration or target-wise blend artifacts. They justify a nested rebuild blueprint, not a submission.
